data: 镜头运动
让观众的视线移动起来
用运动表达发现、追逐、靠近或不安。先问“为什么要动”，再决定怎么动。
推轨 Dolly / Truck
摄影机向前、后或左右平移，空间关系会真实改变。适合靠近人物、跟随行动。
手机沿直线缓慢走近主体，保持速度稳定。
摇 Pan / Tilt
机位不移动，只水平摇或垂直抬俯。适合展示信息或跟随视线。
从门把手摇到人物脸上，让观众先看到线索。
手持 Handheld
保留身体的细小晃动，带来在场感、紧张或纪录感。
同一段路拍三次：稳定、轻微手持、故意剧烈，比较情绪。
环绕 Orbit / Arc
摄影机围绕主体移动，让背景关系不断变化。
让朋友站定，绕半圈拍摄；观察背景如何制造层次。
景别与景框
决定观众离人物多近
景别是情绪距离；景框是你选择让什么进入画面。
远景 / 全景
交代人物与环境的关系，人物在空间中显得渺小或自由。
拍同一个人从远景走到近景，剪在动作连续处。
中景 / 近景
中景保留动作，近景强调表情与关系。
拍一段对话：远景交代位置，近景承接反应。
特写 / 极特写
把注意力锁在眼睛、手、物件或纹理上。
用一个物件特写替代台词，表达角色正在担心什么。
留白与负空间
主体偏向一侧，把空处留给视线或未知。
人物看向画外，画面前方多留空间；再反过来拍比较压迫感。
机位与角度
改变权力、关系与心理
机位不是“好看角度”，而是观众对人物的立场。
平视 Eye level
接近自然观察，关系平等、克制。
把镜头放在眼睛高度拍对话。
低角度 / 高角度
低角度让人物显得强大，高角度让人物显得脆弱或被观察。
同一人物用两个角度拍，其他变量保持不变。
荷兰角 Dutch angle
倾斜地平线，制造失衡、危险或心理不安。
只在情绪发生转折的一镜使用倾斜。
主观镜头 POV
让观众暂时“成为”角色，信息受角色限制。
只给观众角色能看到的内容，再切反应镜头。
灯光
先看方向，再看软硬
灯光的任务是塑造空间、脸和情绪；明亮不等于有层次。
三点布光
主光塑形，辅光控制阴影，轮廓光把人物从背景分开。
用窗户当主光，白纸当反光板，黑衣服当遮光旗。
硬光 / 软光
硬光边缘清晰、戏剧性强；软光包裹、自然、亲密。
同一张脸用直射台灯和隔着白布的台灯拍。
侧光 / 逆光
侧光强调纹理与立体；逆光勾轮廓、制造剪影和神秘。
黄昏拍一个人物轮廓，锁定曝光在天空或脸上各一次。
色温对比
暖光与冷环境并置，能快速建立时间、地点和情绪。
室内用暖台灯，窗外保持冷色，观察画面分区。
构图
安排注意力的路线
构图是信息排序：先看哪里、再看哪里，以及画面之外有什么。
三分法 / 中心构图
三分法自然、灵活；中心构图稳定、正式或有压迫感。
同一主体各拍一张，写下情绪差异。
引导线
道路、窗框、影子和视线把观众带向主体。
找三条线指向人物，避免背景出现无意的“切头”。
前景 / 中景 / 后景
三个深度层让平面画面有空间感。
前景放门框或植物，中景人物，后景放一盏亮灯。
对称与框中框
秩序、仪式感、被困感常来自对称或被框住。
让人物站在门、窗或镜子里，观察边界的心理暗示。
镜头与光学
用焦段和景深改变世界
镜头不是越贵越好；它决定视角、空间压缩和背景如何消失。
广角
视野宽、近处夸张、空间更有速度感。
手机 0.5x 靠近前景物，避免贴脸；观察边缘变形。
长焦
视野窄、背景压缩、适合观察与孤独感。
用 2x/3x 拍同一条街，和广角比较空间距离。
浅景深 / 深景深
浅景深突出主体；深景深让前后信息同时重要。
让人物从背景分离，再把光圈收小拍环境关系。
焦点转移 Rack focus
焦点从前景转到后景，完成一次视觉“转念”。
前景放杯子，后景放人物；手动或锁焦完成转移。
色彩与胶片感
让画面拥有时间和气质
先控制曝光与白平衡，再谈滤镜；颜色服务于叙事。
互补色
冷暖或互补色并置，让主体跳出来。
蓝色环境放一件橙色物件，观察注意力。
单色 / 限色
限制颜色数量，画面更统一、更像一个世界。
拍一组只出现两种主色的物件。
高调 / 低调
高调明亮轻盈；低调阴影多，适合秘密、危险和内省。
同一房间分别用一盏灯和多盏灯拍。
颗粒、光晕与宽银幕感
颗粒增加触感，光晕增加梦境；宽画幅强调横向关系。
后期只加一种质感，比较“原片”和“加效果”的叙事变化。
时间与运动
控制速度、方向和连续性
慢、快、停顿与重复，都是情绪，而不只是技术。
慢动作 / 延时
慢动作放大瞬间，延时压缩漫长变化。
拍水滴或走路：正常、慢动作、延时各一版。
速度变化 Speed ramp
同一镜头内改变速度，强调冲击或转折。
动作开始正常，关键瞬间加速或减速。
屏幕方向连续性
保持人物运动方向，观众才不会迷路。
人物从左向右走，下一镜仍让他往同方向走。
静止与停顿
不动的镜头也能积累等待、尴尬和重量。
在一句台词后多停两秒，再剪掉；比较哪个更有余韵。
机内与光学特效
在拍摄现场制造变化
先做可控、可重复的效果，再追求复杂。
遮挡转场
用手、墙、黑场或物体遮住镜头，接到下一场。
人物经过镜头前完全遮黑时切换地点。
镜面 / 反射
镜子、玻璃和水面可以同时展示人物与空间。
避免穿帮，先锁定反射中的信息，再安排主体。
变焦推拉 Vertigo effect
同时反向移动与变焦，制造空间被拉伸的眩晕。
手机拍摄时缓慢后退并放大，效果以练习为主。
双重曝光 / 光绘
叠加影像或移动光源，适合梦境和主观记忆。
固定手机，夜间用小灯在空中写字，再叠加人物剪影。
剪辑与转场
把镜头连接成思考
剪辑不是把好看的镜头堆在一起，而是安排因果、节奏和视线。
动作剪辑
在动作中切换，观众会自动补全连续性。
关门、坐下、转头各拍两角度，在动作中间切。
匹配剪辑
形状、动作、构图或声音相似，把两个时空连起来。
圆形灯切到太阳，或抬手切到另一场抬手。
交叉剪辑
在两条行动线之间切换，制造平行、对照或悬念。
A 在找钥匙，B 在接近门；逐渐缩短镜头长度。
J-cut / L-cut
声音先于或晚于画面切换，让场景更顺、更有预示。
先听到下一场的声音，再切画面；或画面切走后保留上一句。
氛围与天气
用环境参与叙事
烟、雨、雾、风和自然光既是质感，也是情节力量。
雾 / 烟
降低远景对比、分隔层次，带来未知与梦感。
用安全的薄雾或自然晨雾拍剪影，注意通风与消防。
雨与水面
反光、声音和阻碍让空间更有情绪。
拍地面倒影和雨声，不必先拍大雨。
风与尘
让静止画面“活”起来，暗示外界力量。
用风扇吹布料或头发，观察运动方向对画面的影响。
黄金时刻 / 蓝调时刻
日出日落前后的光线柔和且有色彩，适合建立时间感。
提前 20 分钟到场，固定机位拍一段光线变化。
类型与短视频风格
先理解套路，再决定是否打破
类型是观众的预期；短视频风格是注意力的节奏设计。
黑色电影 Noir
高反差、斜影、百叶窗影子和孤独构图。
只用一盏侧光拍人物走进阴影。
恐怖 / 惊悚
限制信息、延迟揭示、留出画外空间。
不要马上展示声音来源，只拍人物反应。
浪漫 / 生活流
柔和光线、靠近的距离、细节与呼吸感。
拍手、杯子、衣料等细节，再用一个眼神收束。
短视频钩子与节奏
前 1–2 秒给冲突或结果；用动作、字幕和声音维持注意力。
同一主题剪 3 个开头：结果先行、问题先行、反常画面先行。

135mm-telephoto: Name the distant stand and the crowded background. 135mm telephoto on [Subject], stacked planes, eavesdropping compression, background crowding the figure. Add across-the-street or parking-lot throw. Do not write 85mm portrait, and do not ask for wide environmental stretch.
写明「从远处拍」和「拥挤的背景」。135mm 长焦拍 [主体]，空间层次被压扁堆叠，像偷听一样的压缩感，背景向人物挤压。补上「隔着一条街」或「从停车场那么远」。不要写 85mm 人像，也不要要求广角式的环境拉伸。
135mm telephoto on [Subject], stacked planes, eavesdropping compression, background crowding the figure.
135mm 长焦拍 [主体]，层次堆叠，偷听式的压缩感，背景向人物挤压。
24mm-wide: Lead with body in space, not with a mood. 24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage. Name what architecture must remain (door, street, kitchen). Do not ask for extreme distortion, oval bokeh, or a melted background.
从「身体在空间里的位置」写起，而不是从情绪写起。24mm 广角拍 [主体]，环境肖像，身体处于空间中，适度拉伸，报道式取景。写明哪些建筑元素必须保留（门、街道、厨房）。不要要求极端畸变、椭圆形散景或融化般的背景。
24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage cinema.
24mm 广角拍 [主体]，环境肖像，身体置身空间之中，适度拉伸，报道式电影感。
arc-left: 90-degree arc left around [Subject], curved dolly, always facing the figure, background sliding, a quarter-orbit instead of a full spin. For motion: the camera arcs left about 90 degrees around [Subject], always facing them.
绕 [主体] 向左 90 度弧线环绕，弧形推轨，始终朝向人物，背景滑动，是四分之一环绕而不是整圈旋转。用于动态时：摄影机绕 [主体] 向左弧线环绕约 90 度，始终朝向对方。
The camera arcs left about 90 degrees around [Subject], always facing them.
摄影机绕 [主体] 向左弧线环绕约 90 度，始终朝向对方。
axial-cut: Axial cut jumping toward or away from [Subject] along the lens axis, punch-in without a zoom, a snap of scale. Name two or three matched framings, same angle, same pose, hard cuts. For video, do not ask the model to zoom; ask for a cut between a wide and a close on the same axis.
沿镜头轴线朝 [主体] 跳近或跳远的轴向剪辑，不靠变焦的「推近」，一次尺度的骤变。写明两三个对位的取景，同一角度、同一姿态、硬切。用于动态时，不要要求模型变焦；要求在同一轴线上做一个全景与一个近景之间的切。

A librarian notices an impossible new date stamped inside an old book. Make three hard cuts on the same axis: desk-wide, book close-up, extreme close-up of the date. Keep the page and hands fixed, with no zoom animation, morph or lateral angle change. Add exact date text in compositing.
图书管理员发现一本旧书里盖着一个不可能的新日期。在同一个轴线上做三次硬切：桌子全景、书本特写、日期的极特写。页面与手保持固定，不做变焦动画、变形或横向换角度。日期文字在合成时加上。
backlight: Put the source behind the body, not on the nose. " Name hair, coat edge, and whether haze is present. Do not ask for a glowing outline sticker.
把光源放到身体后面，而不是打在鼻子上。写明头发、外套边缘，以及有没有雾霾介质。不要要求那种像贴纸一样的发光轮廓。

A conservator enters a dark archive where one high window sends a narrow hard shaft through suspended dust. Her body briefly interrupts the beam, producing a coherent moving shadow in the haze. Deep room, restrained atmosphere, no magical glowing particles.
一位文物修复员走进昏暗的档案库，一扇高窗射下一道穿过浮尘的窄硬光柱。她的身体短暂挡住光柱，在雾尘中投下连贯移动的影子。房间纵深很深，气氛克制，不要会魔法般发光的粒子。
blue-hour: Keep the sky luminous and cool. Use: "Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in." Forbid a visible sun disk and a black night sky with no residual light.
让天空保持透亮且偏冷。用这句：「[主体] 的蓝调时刻收工镜头，深钴蓝的天空仍有微光，暖色实景灯开始亮起。」禁止出现可见的太阳圆盘，也禁止没有任何残余光线的漆黑夜空。
Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in, Mann twilight melancholy.
[主体] 的蓝调时刻收工镜头，深钴蓝的天空仍有微光，暖色实景灯开始亮起，迈克尔·曼式的黄昏忧郁。
candlelight: Keep the flame small and close. " Cluster the candles, kill electric fill, and let corners go dark. No orange wash on a bright room.
让火焰小而近。把蜡烛聚在一起，关掉电灯补光，让角落沉入黑暗。不要在明亮的房间里铺一层橙色滤镜。

An eighteenth-century card game lit as if only by clustered candles on the table. Faces fade quickly into darkness with distance from the flames, warm uneven illumination, believable flame detail and subdued room corners. A slow restrained gesture, no bright modern fill or electric orange wash.
一场十八世纪的牌局，光照仿佛只来自桌上聚拢的蜡烛。人脸随着离烛火的远近迅速没入黑暗，暖光不均匀，火焰细节真实，房间角落压暗。动作缓慢克制，不要明亮的现代补光，也不要电灯般的橙色调。
centered-composition: Ask for the whole altar. Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar. Name the back wall, matching lamps or windows, camera square to architecture. Do not stop at face in the middle.
要求「完整的祭坛」。[主体] 绝对居中的构图，左右对称或正面舞台式排列，韦斯·安德森式的端正，主体如同祭坛。写明背景墙、成对的壁灯或窗户，摄影机与建筑正面平行。不要只把脸放到画面中间就结束。
Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar.
[主体] 绝对居中的构图，左右对称或正面舞台式排列，韦斯·安德森式的端正，主体如同祭坛。
cinema-verite: Cinéma vérité treatment of [Subject], available light, unpretty frames, zooming to find, mixed color temperature, life unstaged. Name the window or practical. Do not add a rim, a crane, or a recovered-tape timestamp.
[主体] 的真实电影（Cinéma vérité）处理：可用光，不好看的构图，靠变焦去寻找，混合色温，生活不经安排。写明是哪扇窗或哪盏实景灯。不要加轮廓光、摇臂，也不要加「找回的录像带」时间码。
Cinéma vérité treatment of [Subject], available light, unpretty frames, zooming to find, life unstaged.
[主体] 的真实电影（Cinéma vérité）处理：可用光，不好看的构图，靠变焦去寻找，生活不经安排。
close-up: Name the anatomy. Example: Tight close-up of [Subject], head and upper shoulders, 75mm, shallow depth of field. Do not write choker, chest up, or a single eye. Keep a sliver of collar or shoulder so the model does not crop inside the face. For video, hold the head; a pull that reveals waist has become a different size.
写明取哪段身体。例：[主体] 的紧凑近景，头部与上肩，75mm，浅景深。不要写 choker、胸部以上或单只眼睛。保留一点衣领或肩膀，否则模型会切进脸里。用于动态时，保持头部；一旦拉出到腰部，就变成另一个景别了。
Tight close-up of [Subject], head and upper shoulders, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, 75mm Cooke, the face as landscape.
近景拍 [主体]，头部与上肩，浅景深，柔滑的散景，75mm Cooke 镜头，把脸当作风景来拍。
color-shift: Name the before and after. Color shift across [Subject], hues sliding mid-shot or mid-grade, a world that changes temperature in front of us. For motion, say when it happens (through a door, during the take). Do not write a static LUT, and do not confuse it with split-tone.
写明「之前」和「之后」。[主体] 身上的色彩偏移，镜头中段或调色中段色相滑动，一个在我们眼前改变温度的世界。用于动态时，写明发生在什么时候（穿过门时、这一镜进行中）。不要写静态 LUT，也不要与分离色调混为一谈。

Inside a muted sepia workshop, a child opens a large door onto a richly colored greenhouse. Keep the interior sepia while the exterior already exists in color beyond the threshold. As the camera crosses the doorway, enter the full-color world. No dissolve or global color wash.
在低饱和的棕褐色调作坊里，一个孩子推开一扇大门，门外是色彩浓郁的温室。室内保持棕褐调，而门外在门槛之外已是有色的。当摄影机越过门口时，画面进入全彩世界。不要用溶接，也不要整体铺色。
compression: Name the collapsed distances, not only the lens. Telephoto compression stacking [Subject] against a wall of background, distances collapsed, crowded air, no escape in depth. State a far camera. Do not write 14mm, and do not crop a close-stand wide and call it compression.
写明被压扁的距离，而不只是镜头。长焦压缩把 [主体] 压在一面背景墙上，距离被压缩，空气拥挤，纵深上无处可逃。写明摄影机在很远处。不要写 14mm，也不要用广角近拍再冒充压缩。

From far away with a long lens, frame one cyclist approaching along a straight road. Successive streetlights appear densely stacked behind him and his approach seems slow despite steady pedaling. Heat shimmer, fixed camera, no wide-angle expansion or zoom.
用长焦从很远处取景：一名骑车人沿着笔直的道路驶来。一排路灯在他身后被密集地叠在一起，尽管他一直在蹬，靠近的速度看起来却很慢。地面有热浪扰动，摄影机固定，不要广角的扩张感，也不要变焦。
cosmic-horror-look: Cosmic horror framing of [Subject], scale wrong, geometry slightly illegal, under-lit face or a brightness that reveals too much, human irrelevance, extreme long shot or a corridor that does not vanish correctly. Do not prompt a gloved killer.
[主体] 的宇宙恐怖式构图：尺度不对劲，几何关系略微不合常理，脸欠曝，或者亮得揭示了太多，人的无关紧要，用极远景，或者一条消失点不对的走廊。不要写成戴手套的杀手。
Cosmic horror framing of [Subject], scale wrong, geometry slightly illegal, a brightness that reveals too much, human irrelevance.
[主体] 的宇宙恐怖式构图，尺度不对劲，几何略微不合常理，一种揭示得太多的亮，人的无关紧要。
crash-cut: Crash cut on [Subject], two images colliding with no polite blend, a hard join that should sting. Name A and B, the scale or sound collision, and that B may already be mid-event. For video, no dissolve, no fade, no matched contour unless the match is itself the crash.
对 [主体] 的硬切：两个画面相撞，不做客气的过渡，一次本该刺痛的硬接。写明 A 和 B、尺度或声音上的撞击，以及 B 可能已经在事件中途。用于动态时，不要溶接、不要淡入淡出，也不要用匹配轮廓——除非这个匹配本身就是撞击。

Design three sequences: begin with a violinist standing alone on a flooded stage holding an unopened letter; cut to a calm morning before the concert; later return to the stage with the meaning of the letter now clear. Generate each sequence separately and edit the order deliberately. No unrelated mystery props.
设计三段：开头是小提琴手独自站在被水淹的舞台上，手里拿着一封未拆的信；硬切到音乐会前平静的早晨；之后回到舞台，此时信的含义已经清晰。分别生成每一段，再有意识地安排顺序。不要放无关的悬念道具。
cross-cut: Cross-cutting between [Subject] and a simultaneous other line, suspense by alternation, two clocks racing. Name both geographies, what the viewer is invited to assume, and whether that assumption is true. For video, two distinct spaces, alternating shots, tightening duration. Do not morph one room into the other.
在 [主体] 与另一条同时发生的线索之间交叉剪辑，用交替制造悬念，两个时钟在赛跑。写明两个空间各是哪里、引导观众去假设什么，以及这个假设是否成立。用于动态时，两个明确不同的空间、交替的镜头、逐渐缩短的时长。不要让一个房间变形为另一个。

Generate A: a team approaches a building and presses a doorbell. Generate B: someone in a similar interior hears a bell and walks toward a door. Intercut as though they connect. Reveal in a wide reverse that B opens to a lone courier at a different address. Keep the earlier shots ambiguous rather than contradictory.
生成 A：一队人走近一栋楼，按下门铃。生成 B：相似的室内，有人听到铃声并朝门口走去。交叉剪辑，让它们看起来是连贯的。最后用一个宽的反打揭示：B 开门后只有一名快递员，地址完全不同。前面的镜头保持暧昧，而不是自相矛盾。
deep-focus: Demand continuous sharpness, not two cut planes. Example: Deep focus on [Subject] and the far plane, near action and distant doorway both sharp, no rack focus, no split-diopter seam, the eye may wander.
要求连续的清晰，而不是两个切开的平面。例：[主体] 与远处层面的深景深，近处动作与远处门口都清晰，不做焦点转移，没有分光镜的接缝，视线可以自由游走。

Locked wide shot of a courthouse office: a clerk’s hand stamps a form near the lens while an anxious visitor stands in a distant doorway. Both near and far action remain sharply readable, natural perspective, no rack focus, no artificial split-screen seam.
法院办公室的固定宽镜头：书记员的手在近处盖章，同时一位焦虑的访客站在远处的门口。近处与远处的动作都保持清晰可读，透视自然，不做焦点转移，不要人为的分屏接缝。
documentary-look: Documentary look on [Subject], mixed color, unstyled wardrobe light, zoom finding focus, interview or observational coverage, respect without glamour. Name whether this is a sit-down or a follow. Do not add a timestamp or a rim.
[主体] 的纪录片质感：色彩来源混杂，服装与光线都不加修饰，变焦边找焦点，采访或观察式跟拍，尊重而不美化。写明这是坐下访谈还是跟随拍摄。不要加时间码字幕，也不要加轮廓光。

Create a short mockumentary about a municipal committee preparing the world’s smallest parade. Intercut confident seated interviews with observational footage of tiny practical setbacks. Keep interview framing consistent, interviewer mostly offscreen and comedy grounded in sincere behavior rather than broad reaction faces.
做一支短伪纪录片：一个市政委员会正在筹备世界上最小的游行。把自信的坐姿采访与观察式的现场素材交叉剪辑，现场里全是微不足道的现实阻碍。采访构图保持一致，采访者基本在画外，笑点来自真诚的行为，而不是夸张的反应脸。
dolly-in: Physical dolly in toward [Subject] on track, camera body gliding forward, parallax shifting foreground against background, 40mm spherical, buttery traction. For motion: the camera physically dollies forward toward [Subject] for 6 seconds. Foreground parallax, no optical zoom.
在轨道上向 [主体] 物理推轨，机身前移滑行，前后景产生视差位移，40mm 球面镜头，移动如黄油般顺滑。用于动态时：摄影机向 [主体] 物理前推 6 秒。保留前景视差，不要光学变焦。

An archivist sits at a desk and notices a familiar signature on an old letter. Begin in a medium-wide shot. Over eight seconds dolly slowly forward to a close-up, fixed lens, subtle foreground parallax, no zoom. Her eyes lift only at the end. Restrained daylight, no cut.
一位档案管理员坐在桌前，在一封旧信上认出熟悉的签名。以中远景起幅，八秒内缓慢推轨到特写，定焦镜头，轻微的前景视差，不变焦。她的目光直到最后才抬起。克制的日光，不切镜。
dolly-zoom: Dolly zoom on [Subject], camera dollies in while the lens zooms out so the figure stays the same size as the background warps, vertigo spatial contradiction, sickly perspective stretch. For motion: dolly zoom on [Subject]: the camera dollies while the lens counter-zooms so the subject size holds and the background warps.
对 [主体] 做变焦推拉：摄影机前推的同时镜头反向拉远，人物大小不变而背景发生扭曲，眩晕式的空间矛盾，令人不适的透视拉伸。用于动态时：对 [主体] 做变焦推拉——摄影机移动、镜头反向变焦，主体大小保持不变，背景被扭曲。

One continuous six-second shot of a station attendant realizing a train is missing. Dolly straight backward while optically zooming in at the compensating rate. Keep her head exactly the same height and centered; the long platform behind her appears to compress. She barely moves. Stable facial identity, rigid architecture, no cut, no ordinary push-in.
一个连续六秒的镜头：车站值班员意识到一趟列车不见了。摄影机笔直后拉，同时以补偿的比例光学变焦推近。让她的头保持在完全相同的高度并居中；她身后长长的站台看起来被压缩。她几乎不动。面部身份稳定，建筑笔直，不切镜，也不是普通的推近。
dolly-zoom-out: Dolly out, zoom in. Still: Dolly zoom out on [Subject], the figure shrinking or holding while space yawns, a retreat that stretches the room. Video: Dolly out while zooming in on [Subject], background stretching away. Both halves required.
后拉加推近。静帧：[主体] 的变焦拉远，人物缩小或保持大小而空间张开，一次把房间拉长的后退。视频：摄影机后拉的同时对 [主体] 变焦推近，背景被拉向远处。两个动作缺一不可。
Dolly out while zooming in on [Subject], background stretching away.
摄影机后拉的同时对 [主体] 变焦推近，背景被拉向远处。
double-exposure: Name both records and the mix. Example: Double exposure of [Subject] overlaid with a second named image, faces in cities, a ghost in rain, optical composite in camera, both exposures visible, not a morph and not a split-screen join.
写明两次曝光各是什么，以及如何叠加。例：[主体] 的双重曝光，与被明确指出的第二个影像叠合，城市中的面孔、雨中的幽灵，机内光学合成，两层曝光都可见，不是变形，也不是分屏拼接。

A woman argues with an identical version of herself across a kitchen table. Generate each performance as a separate plate from the same locked camera and clean kitchen reference. Match eyelines and timing; keep their silhouettes separate. Composite them together with consistent shadows and no identity blending.
一位女性隔着厨房餐桌与另一个和自己一模一样的人争吵。用同一台锁定摄影机和同一份干净的厨房参考，把两次表演分别生成为独立素材。对齐视线与时机；让两人的剪影保持分离。合成时阴影一致，身份不混在一起。
dust-motes: Dust motes hanging in a shaft of light around [Subject], slow particles, a room that has been closed, time made visible. Name the window or slat, the dark surround, and that particles are discrete, not a fog fill. For video, slow drift inside the beam only.
[主体] 周围的光柱里悬浮着尘埃，缓慢的微粒，一间久闭的房间，时间变得可见。写明是窗户还是百叶缝、四周要暗，以及微粒是一颗颗分明的，而不是用雾填满。用于动态时，只在光柱内部缓慢飘移。
Dust motes hanging in a shaft of light around [Subject], slow particles, a room that has been closed, time made visible.
[主体] 周围的光柱里悬浮着尘埃，缓慢的微粒，一间久闭的房间，时间变得可见。
dust-storm: Dust or sandstorm wrapping [Subject], sun as a dull coin, silhouettes, grit in the highlights. Name wind direction, reduced visibility, and dirty speculars on skin and metal. For video, horizontal grit, flapping cloth, no calm air, no sharp far town unless it is a brief hole in the storm.
风沙或沙尘暴包裹 [主体]，太阳像一枚暗淡的硬币，剪影化，高光里带着颗粒。写明风向、能见度下降，以及皮肤和金属上脏污的镜面反光。用于动态时，横向的沙粒、翻飞的布料，空气不能平静；除非是风暴中短暂的空隙，否则远处的城镇不要拍得清晰。
Dust or sandstorm wrapping [Subject], sun as a dull coin, silhouettes, grit in the highlights, Sicario weather.
[主体] 被风沙或沙尘暴包裹，太阳像一枚暗淡的硬币，剪影化，高光里带着颗粒，《边境杀手》式的天气。
dutch-angle: Name the roll in degrees and keep the buildings straight. Quote: Dutch angle of [Subject], camera rolled 20 to 30 degrees, diagonal horizon, moral or mental tilt. Add: static cant, walls rigid, not a low angle, not a rolling camera. If the model warps anatomy, say natural body proportions, only the horizon is tilted.
用度数说明倾斜量，并让建筑保持笔直。照抄这句：荷兰角拍 [主体]，摄影机侧倾 20 到 30 度，地平线倾斜，道德或心理上的失衡。再补：静态倾斜，墙体笔直，不是低角度，也不是摄影机在滚动。如果生成模型容易把人拍变形，就写明「自然的人体比例，只有地平线是倾斜的」。

A tenant confronts a landlord in a narrow stairwell. Static camera canted fifteen degrees, strong diagonal banister, rigid walls and natural anatomy. Both actors remain grounded. No rolling camera, fisheye distortion or vibrating image; the tension comes from the tilted composition.
租客在狭窄楼梯间质问房东。摄影机静止并侧倾十五度，扶手形成强烈对角线，墙体笔直，人体比例自然。两人都站在地面上。不要滚动镜头、鱼眼变形或抖动的画面；紧张感来自倾斜的构图。
establishing-shot: Declare place and time. Example: Wide establishing shot of [Subject] and the location at once, time of day and spatial relations declared before coverage begins. Name the hour, the weather, and what building or street this is. For video, a small environmental motion (traffic, steam, a flag) is enough; do not tour if the job is only to plant geography.
交代地点与时间。例：[主体] 与场景同时出现的宽幅建立镜头，在开始分镜之前先声明时间、天气与空间关系。写明钟点、天气，以及这是哪栋建筑或哪条街。用于动态时，一点环境动向（车流、蒸汽、旗帜）就够了；如果任务只是确立地理关系，就不要做游览式运镜。

After a daughter leaves the house, hold a static shot of the empty entryway: her shoes are gone, afternoon light remains on the floor and distant street noise continues. No person enters, no camera move, no sentimental insert music. Cut to the next scene only after the room has registered as its own space.
女儿离家之后，用一个静止镜头停在空玄关：她的鞋不见了，午后的光还留在地板上，远处的街声继续。没有人入画，摄影机不动，不加煽情的插入音乐。等这个空间被观众认成「它自己」之后，再切到下一场。
extreme-close-up: Lead with the crop, then the feature. Example: Extreme close-up of [Subject], a single feature filling the frame, pores and texture, tighter than forehead-to-chin. Name which feature (left eye, mouth, fingertip, trigger) and what must stay sharp. Do not write tight close-up, choker, or macro unless you actually need those. For video, lock the camera, keep the feature in frame, and allow only a blink, a swallow, or a tiny gaze shift.
先说取景范围，再说具体部位。例：极特写中的 [主体]，单一部位填满画面，毛孔与质感可见，比「额头到下巴」更紧。指明是哪个部位（左眼、嘴、指尖、扳机），以及哪里必须保持清晰。若不是真的需要，不要写「紧特写」「choker」「微距」。用于动态时，锁定摄影机，让该部位保持画内，只允许一次眨眼、一次吞咽或极小的视线移动。

Extreme close-up of an older watchmaker’s eyes as she decides whether to open a sealed mechanism. Frame from brow to upper cheek, natural skin texture, tiny shift in gaze and controlled breathing. Restrained light, stable focus, no cosmetic smoothing or wide-angle facial distortion.
极特写一位年长制表师的眼睛，她正在决定要不要打开一个封死的机芯。取景从眉到上颊，自然的皮肤质感，视线极小的移动，呼吸克制。光线克制，焦点稳定，不要磨皮，也不要有广角的面部变形。
extreme-long-shot: Say speck and name the terrain. Example: Extreme long shot of [Subject] as a speck against vast terrain, infinite depth of field, landscape as the true subject. Demand a detectable human-scale reference. For video, a tiny walk or a dust veil helps the figure read; a locked empty canyon with no marker will look like a maquette.
写出「一个小点」，并说清地形。例：极远景中的 [主体] 只是广袤地形上的一个小点，无限景深，风景才是真正的主体。要求画面里有可辨识的人体尺度参照。用于动态时，一点点走动或一层尘雾能让身形被看清；如果只是空无一人的峡谷静镜、没有任何参照，看起来会像模型。

Extreme-wide static shot of a lone surveyor in a yellow coat at the base of an enormous concrete spillway. The figure is tiny but unmistakable; immense walls recede naturally. Slow drifting mist, no camera move, no giant-person scale errors.
极宽静态镜头：一名穿黄外套的测量员独自站在巨大的混凝土泄洪道底部。人极小但一眼可辨；巨大的墙体自然向远处退去。缓慢飘动的薄雾，摄影机不动，不要出现把人拍成巨人的比例错误。
eye-level: Lead with height and pitch. Quote: Eye-level shot of [Subject], camera at their eye height, horizontal sightline, equal relationship, no power tilt. Name that the horizon is level. Add a 35mm or 50mm if you want human perspective. Do not write mood words in place of the height.
先说高度与俯仰。照抄这句：平视镜头拍 [主体]，摄影机位于其眼睛高度，视线水平，关系平等，不做权力倾斜。写明地平线是水平的。想要接近人眼视角就补上 35mm 或 50mm。不要用情绪词代替高度。
Eye-level shot of [Subject], camera at their eye height, horizontal sightline, equal relationship, no power tilt.
平视镜头拍 [主体]，摄影机位于其眼睛高度，视线水平，关系平等，不做权力倾斜。
film-grain: Specify format and that the grain is in the image, not on it. Example: Visible film grain over [Subject], 35mm or 16mm dye-cloud texture, temporally unstable, denser in shadows, not a cheap overlay.
写明画幅格式，并说明颗粒是「画面里长出来的」，不是「贴上去的」。例：[主体] 身上可见的胶片颗粒，35mm 或 16mm 的染料云质感，随时间有机跳动，暗部更密，而不是廉价叠加层。
Visible film grain over [Subject], 35mm or 16mm texture, living silver, not a cheap overlay.
[主体] 身上可见的胶片颗粒，35mm 或 16mm 质感，活的银盐，而不是廉价叠加层。
film-noir: Lead with the treatment, then lock physics. Film-noir treatment of [Subject], hard venetian gobos, unfilled far cheek, wet-down street bounce, 50mm spherical, 1940s crime blocking. Name who stands where and which practical is the motivated key. Do not replace the gobo, the ratio, and the wet pavement with mood adjectives.
先写处理手法，再锁定物理逻辑。[主体] 的黑色电影处理：硬朗的百叶窗遮光图案，远侧脸颊不补光，打湿街道的反光，50mm 球面镜头，1940 年代犯罪片的调度。写明谁站在哪里，以及哪盏实景灯是有动机的主光。不要用情绪形容词代替遮光图案、光比和湿路面。
Film-noir treatment of [Subject], hard venetian gobos, wet streets, fedora shadows, moral night, 1940s crime grammar.
[主体] 的黑色电影处理，硬朗的百叶窗光影，湿漉漉的街道，礼帽的影子，道德的黑夜，1940 年代犯罪片的语法。
first-person: Require a body at the edges. Quote: First-person camera as [Subject] would see, hands entering frame, breath, a body that owns the lens. Video: First-person view moving as [Subject] moves, hands or tools entering the edges. Add: no owner's face except a reflection, eye height of that person, not a drone, not an OTS shoulder.
要求画面边缘有身体。照抄这句：第一人称摄影机呈现 [主体] 所见的画面，手从画面入镜，有呼吸，有一具拥有这枚镜头的身体。视频：第一人称视角随 [主体] 的动作移动，手或工具从画面边缘入画。再补：除了倒影不出现本人的脸，处于那个人的眼睛高度，不是无人机，也不是过肩镜头的肩膀。
First-person view moving as [Subject] moves, hands or tools entering the edges.
第一人称视角，随 [主体] 的动作一起移动，手或工具从画面边缘入画。
focus-change: Focus change on [Subject], the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact, a rack without apology. Video: Focus changes from one plane onto [Subject] or away from them. Name both planes and that the mid-blur is brief.
对 [主体] 的焦点变化：清晰平面跳跃或滑动到新的事实上，一次不加抱歉的焦点转移。视频：焦点从一个层面转移到 [主体] 身上或移开。写明两个层面，以及中间虚焦的时间很短。
Focus changes from one plane onto [Subject] or away from them.
焦点从一个层面转移到 [主体] 身上，或从 [主体] 身上移开。
foreground-interest: Name the near object and whether it is sharp. Strong foreground object between lens and [Subject], dirty aperture of flowers, fence, or glass, layered depth. Say between lens and subject, and what the object is. If it should stay readable, say foreground sharp. If it is a veil, say out of focus foreground.
写明近处的物件，以及它是否清晰。镜头与 [主体] 之间强烈的前景物件，花、栅栏或玻璃形成的「脏框」，营造层次纵深。说明它在镜头与主体之间、是什么东西。如果它要保持可读，就写「前景清晰」；如果它是纱幕，就写「前景虚化」。

Observe two neighbors speaking softly in a stairwell through a narrow gap between a door and its frame. A dark blurred door edge occupies one third of the image. The camera remains hidden and still; both faces remain readable when they lean toward the light.
透过门与门框之间一道窄缝，观察两位邻居在楼梯间低声交谈。模糊的暗色门边占据画面三分之一。摄影机隐藏且静止；当两人凑向光亮时，两张脸都要保持可读。
frame-in-frame: Name both rectangles. Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention. Describe the jamb, the threshold, and which space is brighter. Say whether we are inside looking out or outside looking in.
写明两个矩形。围绕 [主体] 的框中框：门洞、窗户、镜子或拱门作为第二个矩形，注意力被套叠。描述门框、门槛，以及哪个空间更亮。写明我们是「在里面向外看」还是「在外面向里看」。

From inside a dim farmhouse, hold on a bright rectangular doorway framing a lone traveler outside. The family passes into the room while the traveler remains beyond the threshold. Locked wide shot, no push-in, natural exposure contrast.
从昏暗的农舍内部看向一个明亮的矩形门洞，门洞把屋外独自站着的旅人框住。家人走进房间，而旅人始终留在门槛之外。固定宽镜头，不推近，曝光对比自然。
giallo-look: Giallo look on [Subject], hyper-saturated primaries, gelled window key, black leather implied in the foreground, 35mm zoom threat, Argento color crime. Name the red, green, or cobalt source. Do not prompt a black-and-white alley.
[主体] 的铅黄（Giallo）风格，高饱和的三原色，带色纸的窗光作主光，前景暗示黑色皮手套，35mm 变焦的威胁感，阿基多式的彩色犯罪。写明红、绿或钴蓝的光源。不要写成黑白小巷。
Giallo look on [Subject], hyper-saturated primaries, black leather gloves implied, Argento color crime, beauty as threat.
[主体] 的铅黄（Giallo）风格，高饱和的三原色，暗示黑色皮手套，阿基多式的彩色犯罪，美本身成为威胁。
golden-hour: Keep the sun low and real. " Say the sun is just above the horizon. Forbid midday height and a full blue sky with no rake.
让太阳低而真实。写明太阳刚在地平线之上。禁止正午的高度，也禁止没有斜射角度的整片蓝天。

Two farm workers walk beside a wheat field just after sunset. Soft luminous sky, low contrast on their faces, warm remnants on the horizon, no direct overhead sun. Gentle wind and patient lateral movement, natural exposure, no exaggerated orange filter.
日落刚过，两名农工走在麦田边。天空柔和透亮，他们脸上对比很低，地平线上还留着暖色，没有头顶直射的太阳。轻风与克制的横向移动，曝光自然，不要夸张的橙色滤镜。
graphic-match: Graphic match on the silhouette of [Subject], shape echoing shape, circle to circle, a visual rhyme. Specify the shared contour, its screen position, and that the objects stay distinct. For video: generate A and B with the same dominant shape size and placement, then hard-cut. No morph, no dissolve unless you explicitly want a soft rhyme.
对 [主体] 轮廓的图形匹配：形状呼应形状，圆接圆，一次视觉押韵。写明共用的轮廓、它在画面中的位置，以及两个物件保持各自独立。视频：生成 A、B，让主导形状的大小与位置一致，然后硬切。不要变形，也不要溶接——除非你明确想要一次柔和的押韵。

Generate A: close-up of a circular watch face centered in frame. Generate B: a circular observatory dome seen from above at exactly the same size and position. Hard-cut on the shared circle, with no morph or dissolve. Keep the two objects distinct and the visual connection immediate.
生成 A：居中构图的圆形表盘特写。生成 B：俯拍一个圆形天文台穹顶，大小与位置完全一致。在共用的圆形上硬切，不要变形，也不要溶接。两个物件保持各自独立，视觉关联要立刻成立。
halation: Bloom the highlight edge, not the whole room. Example: Halation glow around highlights on [Subject], red-edge bloom of film stock, lamps breathing, eyes and fabric texture preserved, not a global fog.
让高光边缘发光，而不是整个房间发光。例：[主体] 高光周围的光晕，胶片式的红色边缘溢出，灯泡在呼吸，眼睛与布料质感保留，不是全局雾化。

A woman reads beside a bright summer window. Fine facial detail stays readable while window highlights bloom gently into the surrounding air. Subtle soft filtration, luminous skin without smoothing away texture, no fog overlay or global defocus.
一位女性在明亮的夏日窗边读书。面部细节保持可读，而窗外的高光柔和地晕散到周围的空气里。轻微的柔光滤镜，皮肤透亮但不磨掉质感，不要整体雾化，也不要全局虚化。
handheld: Handheld camera on [Subject], breathing micro-shake, documentary immediacy, Super 16 grain feel, the operator's body in the frame's nerves. For motion: handheld camera with natural operator shake holding [Subject] in frame. Organic micro-tremors, no stabilization.
手持摄影拍 [主体]，呼吸般的细微抖动，纪录片的现场感，Super 16 颗粒质感，把摄影者的身体写进画面的神经里。用于动态时：手持摄影机带着自然的抖动，把 [主体] 稳在画内。有机的微颤，不做稳定处理。

Inside a moving minibus, a compact camera pivots from two chatting passengers to the windscreen as a fallen tree blocks the road, then to the driver’s reaction and the rear window. One continuous-looking viewpoint, consistent seats, believable window parallax, restrained panic. Build separate interior and exterior plates when necessary.
在行驶的小巴车内，一台小型摄影机从两位闲聊的乘客转向挡风玻璃——倒下的树挡住了路——再转向司机的反应和后窗。保持单一连续视点，座椅位置一致，窗外视差可信，慌乱克制。必要时分别生成车内与车外素材。
hard-light: Name a small distant source and razor edges. Use: "Hard light on [Subject] from a small distant source, razor shadow edges, texture amplified, noir graphic." Forbid silks, wrap, and cloudy softness unless weather is the point.
写明一个又小又远的光源和刀锋般的阴影边缘。用这句：「[主体] 上的硬光，来自小而远的光源，阴影边缘锐利，质感被放大，黑色电影式的图形感。」除非天气本身就是重点，否则禁止柔光布、包裹光和云一样的柔和。
Hard light on [Subject] from a small distant source, razor shadow edges, texture amplified, noir graphic.
[主体] 上的硬光，来自小而远的光源，阴影边缘锐利，质感被放大，黑色电影式的图形感。
haze: Atmospheric haze stacking distance around [Subject], aerial perspective, far planes paler, depth as weather. Keep the near subject contrasty; name two or three receding planes. For video, stable long-distance paleness, not swirling soup around the lens. No globes on a foreground practical unless you also have local fog.
[主体] 周围由大气薄雾堆叠出距离感，空气透视，越远越淡，把天气当作纵深的度量。让近处的主体保持对比；写明两到三个逐层退远的层面。用于动态时，是稳定的远距离发白，而不是在镜头前翻滚的浓汤。除非同时有局部雾，否则不要在前景实景灯上套光晕球。
Atmospheric haze stacking distance around [Subject], aerial perspective, far planes paler, depth as weather.
[主体] 周围由大气薄雾堆叠出距离感，空气透视，越远越淡，把天气当作纵深的度量。
high-angle: Name the look-down, not only camera up high. Quote: High-angle shot looking down on [Subject], the figure diminished, architecture or sky weighing on them. Add: oblique angle, face still readable, more floor than ceiling, horizon not level to the eyes. Forbid 90-degree top-down unless you actually want Overhead Top-Down.
写明「向下看」，而不只是「机位高」。照抄这句：高角度俯拍 [主体]，人物被压小，建筑或天空在压迫他。再补：斜俯视角，脸依然可读，画面里地板多于天花板，地平线不与眼睛齐平。除非你真的要正俯视，否则禁止 90 度垂直向下。

High oblique view of a lone cleaner crossing a vast empty railway hall after midnight. The architecture and floor pattern dominate. The cleaner pauses at a distant sound. Fixed elevated viewpoint, no drone swoop or zoom.
高角度斜俯视：午夜后，一名清洁工独自穿过空旷巨大的火车站大厅。建筑与地面图案占主导。清洁工被远处的声音惊得停下。固定的高机位视点，不要无人机式俯冲，也不要变焦。
high-key: Ask for low contrast and protected whites, not a flash. " Add large sources and say highlights hold texture. Avoid calling it low-key just because the genre is serious.
要求低对比与「高光不死白」，而不是闪光灯感。补上大面积光源，并写明高光仍有质感。不要因为题材严肃就把它写成低调。

A meticulously cheerful pastry shop at midday, soft broad light, luminous pastel walls and gentle shadows. The owner stands motionless while everyone else smiles. High-key image with preserved white icing texture, no blown highlights or glossy skin.
正午时分一间刻意欢快的糕点店，柔和宽广的光，透亮的柔粉墙面与轻柔阴影。店主一动不动，其他人都在微笑。高调画面，白色糖霜的质感保留，高光不过曝，皮肤不油腻。
insert: Name the object and the scale. Example: Tight close-up of an object that carries the plot near [Subject]: a glass, a letter, a latch. Hands at real scale. No glowing skin. Match the room's key. For video, a small physical change (a tremor, a thumb on a latch) is the motion; do not orbit the prop.
写明物件与尺寸。例：在 [主体] 附近承载剧情的物件特写：一只杯子、一封信、一个门闩。手按真实比例。皮肤不要发光。与该房间的主光一致。用于动态时，一点物理变化（一次轻颤、拇指按上门闩）就是动作；不要让道具转圈。

Outline a short caper around an unopened blue envelope sought by three strangers. Never reveal its contents. Build the scenes around shifting trust, mistaken possession and one character choosing a friend over the envelope. Generate a consistent, easily trackable prop for every shot.
围绕一个从未拆开的蓝色信封写一段短小闹剧，三拨陌生人都在找它。永远不揭示内容。用信任的转移、拿错东西和「有人为了朋友放弃信封」来搭建场景。每一镜都要生成同一个、易于辨认追踪的道具。
l-cut-visual: A frame of [Subject] designed as the picture half of an L-cut or J-cut, reaction holding while another space is already speaking. For stills, describe a listening face or a doorway that can hold offscreen voice. For video, specify whether audio of B starts under A (J) or audio of A continues under B (L), and name both spaces.
[主体] 的一个画面，被设计成 L-cut 或 J-cut 中「画面」的那一半：反应镜头保持着，而另一个空间的声音已经进来。静帧时，描述一张在倾听的脸，或一个能承载画外声音的门洞。视频时，明确是 B 的声音先压着 A 的画面起来（J-cut），还是 A 的声音延续到 B 的画面之下（L-cut），并把两个空间都写出来。

A cheerful original corporate jingle plays over a spotless office being emptied after a sudden closure. Workers quietly pack plants and family photographs while the tune maintains its bright tempo. Generate restrained visual coverage and compose an original cue; do not imitate an existing recording or melody.
一段欢快的原创企业广告歌，盖在一个因突然倒闭而正在被搬空、纤尘不染的办公室画面上。员工安静地打包绿植和家庭照片，而旋律保持明亮的节拍。生成克制的画面素材，并创作一段原创配乐；不要模仿已有的录音或旋律。
layered-depth: Assign jobs to planes. Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging. Name what happens near, middle, and far. Say whether all planes are sharp or which one holds focus. Do not write 3D as a slogan.
给每一层分配任务。[主体] 周围的三层构图：前景、中景、深后景都承载信息，纵深调度。写明近处、中间、远处各自发生什么。说明是三层都清晰，还是焦点落在哪一层。不要把「3D」当成口号写上去。

A landlord signs a document in the near foreground while, through an open doorway, a family quietly packs in the distant room. Hold both actions in one wide composition. The foreground gesture must not obscure the family. No cut or explanatory insert.
房东在近前景签文件，同时透过敞开的门，远处房间里一家人正在安静地收拾行李。用一个宽构图把两个动作同时拿下。前景的动作不能挡住那家人。不切镜，也不要解释性的插入镜头。
lead-room: Name the direction of the surplus. Lead room in front of [Subject]'s look or walk, more space in the direction of attention than behind, forward narrative. Say looking left or walking right, more frame ahead of the face than behind the head. Do not write balanced.
写明「多出来的空间」在哪个方向。[主体] 视线或行进方向前方的留白，朝向那侧比背后留得多，叙事上是「向前」。写明是向左看还是向右走，脸前方比脑后留得多。不要写「平衡」。
Lead room in front of [Subject]'s look or walk, more space in the direction of attention than behind, forward narrative.
在 [主体] 视线或行进方向的前方留出空间（Lead Room）：朝向的那侧比背后留得多，叙事上是「向前」。
leading-lines: Name the vector and the landing. Leading lines driving the eye to [Subject], rails, corridors, roads, or shadows converging on the figure. Say what the lines are made of. If they should miss the person and continue, say the figure is a gate, lines continuing to a distant point.
写明「引导的向量」和「落点」。引导线把视线带向 [主体]：铁轨、走廊、道路或阴影汇聚到人物身上。说清这些线是由什么构成的。如果你希望线条穿过人物继续延伸，就写「人物是一道门，线条继续通向远处的消失点」。
Leading lines driving the eye to [Subject], rails, corridors, roads, or shadows converging on the figure.
引导线把视线带向 [主体]，铁轨、走廊、道路或阴影汇聚到人物身上。
light-flash: Make it an event with a recovery. Still: Blinding light flash over [Subject], a bulb, explosion, or memory cut, the frame going to white then returning. Video: A hard light flash blows out [Subject] then settles back, as a memory or explosion sting.
让它成为一次有回落的事件。静帧：[主体] 身上刺目的光闪，灯泡、爆炸或记忆的闪断，画面冲到白色再回来。视频：一道硬光闪光把 [主体] 打爆，随后回落，用作回忆或爆炸的刺痛感。
A hard light flash blows out [Subject] then settles back, as a memory or explosion sting.
一道硬光闪光把 [主体] 打爆，随后回落，用作回忆或爆炸的刺痛感。
long-take: Write unbroken duration and what happens in depth. Still: a wide ensemble with a readable route, not proof of a take. Video: An unbroken long take following [Subject] through the space with no cut. Name foreground, midground, and background actions on one timeline.
写出不间断的时长和纵深里发生的事。静帧：一个路线可读的宽幅群像，而不是「长镜头」的证明。视频：一个不间断的长镜头跟随 [主体] 穿过空间，不切。写明前景、中景、后景在一条时间线上各自发生的动作。

Follow a harbor nurse through an improvised waiting area after a storm. In one flowing shot, pass people playing cards, repairing a radio, tending injuries and staring silently at the sea. No disaster spectacle; distinct actions continue independently in depth. Keep the nurse as a loose visual anchor.
风暴之后，跟随一名港口护士穿过临时安置区。用一个流动的长镜头经过打牌的人、修收音机的人、处理伤口的人和沉默望着海的人。不要灾难奇观；各个动作在纵深里各自独立地继续。让护士作为一条松散的视觉锚线。
low-angle: Name the look-up and the ceiling. Quote: Low-angle shot looking up at [Subject], converging verticals, heroic or oppressive height, Citizen Kane floor. Add: camera below their eyes, horizon low, ceiling or sky in frame, face still a portrait. Ban from the ground looking straight up unless you want Worm's-Eye View.
写明「仰视」和天花板。照抄这句：低角度仰拍 [主体]，垂直线向上收敛，崇高或压迫的高度感，《公民凯恩》式的低机位。再补：摄影机在眼睛以下，地平线偏低，天花板或天空入画，脸依然是一张肖像。除非你要的正是虫视角，否则禁止从地面笔直向上拍。

A quiet family conversation in a modest room, filmed from a low seated height with the camera level. Two adults sit beside a low table, doorways carefully balanced, no dramatic upward angle. Locked shot, small natural gestures, patient pauses.
在简朴房间里的一场安静家庭对话，从坐着时的低位高度、以水平视角拍摄。两名成年人坐在矮桌旁，门框在画面中平衡得当，不要夸张的上仰角度。固定镜头，细小的自然动作，耐心的停顿。
low-key: Name the pool and the black. " Name the single source and forbid extra fill. Do not write moody if you have not placed the lamp.
写明那一小片光和黑。写明唯一的光源，禁止额外补光。如果你还没安排灯位，就不要写「阴郁」。
Low-key lighting on [Subject], most of the frame in deep shadow, one pool of light, 8:1 contrast, noir darkness as a character.
[主体] 的低调布光，画面大部分沉在深阴影中，只有一小片光，8:1 的光比，黑暗本身成为黑色电影里的一个角色。
match-action: Match on action through [Subject]'s gesture, the motion started in one shot and finished in the next. Name the wide and the close, the hand, the object, the direction of travel, and that the cut happens during the move. For video, generate A and B of the same reach or step, then cut mid-motion. Do not reverse the hand or the walk.
用 [主体] 的动作做动作剪辑：动作在一个镜头里开始，在下一个镜头里完成。写明全景与特写、哪只手、什么物件、运动方向，以及剪辑点落在动作过程中。用于动态时，把同一个伸手或迈步生成 A、B 两段，然后在动作中段切。不要把手的方向或行走方向弄反。

Generate A: wide view of a courier reaching for a door handle with the right hand. Generate B: close view from the same side of the action axis, continuing that exact reach and turning the handle. Cut during the reach, preserving hand, speed, sleeve and handle position.
生成 A：快递员用右手去握门把手的全景。生成 B：从动作轴同一侧拍的近景，延续同一次伸手并转动把手。在伸手过程中切，保持手、速度、袖子和把手位置一致。
match-cut: Write both sides of the join. Example: Match cut from [Subject] to a rhyming shape or motion in another time, graphic continuity across a hard cut, bone to station. Name the shared contour or vector, name what changes (place, era, scale), and forbid a morph or dissolve. For video, generate A and B as separate shots with matched screen position, then cut; do not ask the model to blend them.
把衔接的两端都写清楚。例：从 [主体] 匹配剪辑到一个在形状或运动上押韵的对象，跨越硬切保持图形连续，骨头接空间站。写明共用的轮廓或向量，写明变化的是什么（地点、年代、尺度），并禁止变形或溶接。用于动态时，把 A、B 生成为两个画面位置对位的独立镜头再切；不要要求模型把它们混合。

In an early workshop scene, casually show a door that sticks unless lifted slightly. Later, during an urgent evacuation, a visitor fails to open it until the apprentice remembers the trick. Generate the same door hardware and motion in both scenes. Avoid a conspicuous explanatory close-up in the setup.
在早期工坊的场景里，不经意地展示一扇必须轻轻抬起才能打开的门。之后在一次紧急疏散中，一位访客打不开它，直到学徒想起这个窍门。两场戏使用同一套门具与同样的动作。铺垫时不要用显眼的解释性特写。
medium-shot: Say waist. Example: Medium shot of [Subject] from the waist up, conversational distance, 50mm, gesture and face in balance. Do not write chest up, mid-thigh, or head and shoulders. For video, if the camera drifts down to the knees you have entered cowboy territory.
写明「腰部」。例：中景中的 [主体]，从腰部以上取景，谈话距离，50mm，动作与面部比重均衡。不要写成胸部以上、大腿中部或头肩。用于动态时，如果取景向下滑到膝盖，就已经变成牛仔景别了。
Medium shot of [Subject] from the waist up, conversational distance, 50mm, gesture and face in balance.
中景拍 [主体]，腰部以上，谈话距离，50mm，动作与面部比重均衡。
monochrome: Ban hue explicitly. Monochrome treatment of [Subject], silver highlights, deep blacks, no chroma, shape and light only. Name the grey scale (deep blacks, silver highlights). Do not write sepia, and do not leave a teal wash.
明确禁用色彩。[主体] 的单色处理：银白高光，深黑，无任何色度，只留形状与光。写明灰度走向（深黑与银白高光）。不要写棕褐，也不要留下青色偏色。
Monochrome treatment of [Subject], silver highlights, deep blacks, no chroma, shape and light only.
[主体] 的单色处理，银白高光，深黑，无色度，只有形状与光。
multiverse: Same person, separable worlds. Multiverse split of [Subject], many versions, many grades, the same person in parallel rooms. Add two or three wardrobes, two or three grades, architecture repeating with variations, identity locked. No mush.
同一个人，可分离的世界。[主体] 的多重宇宙分割：许多版本、许多调色，同一个人身处平行的房间。补上两三套造型、两三种调色，建筑在重复中变化，身份锁定。不要一团糊。

Plan three connected worlds: a real hospital room, a dreamed railway station and a deeper childhood kitchen. Give each one distinct sound, light and a recurring object. A falling cup in the hospital creates a distant rumble in the station and a tremor in the kitchen. Generate and edit the levels separately with a consistent causal map.
规划三个互相连通的世界：真实的病房、梦中的火车站、更深层的童年厨房。给每一个世界独立的声音、光线和一个反复出现的物件。病房里掉落的杯子，在车站引起一声远处的闷响，在厨房引起一次震动。各层分别生成与剪辑，但要有一张一致的因果图。
negative-space: Say what is empty and where the body sits. Vast negative space around [Subject], the figure small, absence as weight, Antonioni emptiness. Name the field (wall, sky, snow, sea) and the placement (low in frame, far right, a speck). Do not write lonely as a substitute for geometry.
说清哪里是空的、人坐在哪里。[主体] 周围留出大片负空间，人物很小，用「缺席」制造重量，安东尼奥尼式的空。指明空的是什么（墙、天空、雪、海）以及位置（画面下部、最右侧、一个小点）。不要用「孤独」这类词代替几何关系。

A young woman sits in the bottom-right corner of a tall, nearly empty waiting room. Most of the frame is pale wall and high windows. She looks toward the near edge rather than into the empty space. Static shot, restrained performance, no decorative camera movement.
一位年轻女性坐在高挑、几乎空无一人的候诊室右下角。画面大部分是浅色墙面和高窗。她望向近处的边缘，而不是望向空处。静止镜头，表演克制，不做装饰性运镜。
neo-noir: Neo-noir look on [Subject], color where classic noir was silver, neon practicals, rain, contemporary crime blocking, hard key, unfilled far cheek. Name the hue of the signage and whether the camera is locked or tracking. Do not write only teal and orange.
[主体] 的新黑色电影风格：经典黑色电影是银灰，这里用彩色；霓虹实景光，雨，当代犯罪片的调度，硬主光，远侧脸颊不补光。写明招牌的色相，以及摄影机是锁定还是跟移。不要只写青橙。
Neo-noir look on [Subject], color where classic noir was silver, neon practicals, rain, contemporary crime melancholy.
[主体] 的新黑色电影风格：经典黑色电影是银灰，这里用彩色；霓虹实景光，雨，当代犯罪片的忧郁。
neon-practical: Make the signs the keys. " Name which tube hits which cheek. Forbid a white beauty key.
让招牌本身成为主光。写明哪根灯管打在谁的哪边脸颊上。禁止白色的美颜主光。
Neon practicals coloring [Subject], magenta and cyan signs as real keys, wet bounce, mixed gels, night-city chromatics.
霓虹实景光染在 [主体] 上，品红与青色招牌作为真实主光，湿地反光，混合色纸，夜城的色彩学。
one-point-perspective: Demand a single vanishing point and a square camera. One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity. Name the receding architecture. Say camera on the centerline, verticals true. If the person is the target, put the point on them. If they are a gate, put the point beyond.
要求单一消失点与正对建筑的机位。朝向 [主体] 或穿过 [主体] 的单点透视走廊，消失点在轴线上，库布里克式的无限延伸。写明向远处退去的建筑。说明摄影机在中轴线上，垂直线笔直。如果人物是目标，就把消失点放在他身上；如果他是一道门，就把消失点放到更远处。

A lone night porter stands centered at the end of a perfectly symmetrical hotel corridor. Locked axial camera, central vanishing point, balanced lamps and doorways. Hold still as one door on the far left opens slightly, breaking the order. No camera move.
一名夜班行李员独自站在完全对称的酒店走廊尽头正中。锁定轴向机位，单一中心消失点，壁灯与门洞左右配重。镜头静置，直到最左远处的一扇门轻轻打开，打破秩序。摄影机不移动。
orbit-360: Full 360-degree orbit around [Subject], camera circling at constant radius, background becoming a continuous ribbon of light, centripetal romantic or predatory energy. For motion: the camera orbits 360 degrees around [Subject], always facing them, background wrapping as a ribbon of light.
围绕 [主体] 做完整 360 度环绕，摄影机以恒定半径绕行，背景连成一条连续的光带，带来向心的浪漫感或捕猎感。用于动态时：摄影机绕 [主体] 环行 360 度，始终朝向对方，背景像光带一样卷绕。

Orbit clockwise 120 degrees around a violinist standing still in an empty circular hall. Keep her eyes near the same point in frame, natural live-speed motion, constant camera distance, no zoom. Columns reveal genuine changing perspective. One uninterrupted eight-second take.
在空荡的圆形大厅里，围绕站着不动的小提琴手顺时针环绕 120 度。让她的眼睛保持在画面中大致相同的位置，实时速度，摄影机距离恒定，不变焦。柱子在绕行中呈现真实的透视变化。一个不间断的八秒长镜头。
palette: Name the allowed hues and ban the rest. Restricted palette on [Subject], a few chosen hues doing all the work, design as law. List the two or three hues. Do not write mixed complementary clutter, and do not say colorful.
写明允许的颜色，其余全部禁止。[主体] 的受限色板，少数几个选定的色相承担全部工作，设计即法则。列出那两三个色相。不要写互相冲突的互补色堆砌，也不要说「色彩丰富」。

Generate three matched views of one train-station meeting as alternate recollections: warm amber, cool blue-gray and restrained white-green. Keep blocking and character identities identical while wardrobe accents, environment and light follow each version’s palette. Assemble as distinct narrative strands rather than cycling hues within one shot.
把同一次车站相遇生成三个对位的版本，作为三种不同的回忆：暖琥珀、冷蓝灰、克制的白绿。调度与人物身份保持一致，而服装点缀、环境与光线各随其色板。把它们编成三条独立的叙事线，而不是在一个镜头里循环换色。
pan-left: Slow pan left from a locked tripod across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis, horizon level, revealing new architecture to the left. For motion: the camera pans left from a fixed tripod, sweeping across [Subject] and the environment. No body travel.
在锁定的三脚架上向左缓慢摇摄，扫过 [主体]，摄影机绕垂直轴旋转，地平线保持水平，向左侧逐步揭示新的建筑。用于动态时：摄影机在固定三脚架上向左摇，扫过 [主体] 与环境。机身不移动。
The camera pans left from a fixed tripod, sweeping across [Subject] and the environment. No body travel.
摄影机在固定三脚架上向左摇摄，扫过 [主体] 与周围环境。机身不移动。
pass-through: Name the barrier and the far side. Still: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional. Video: The camera passes through architecture or [Subject] into the next space. Show the hole. Forbid a hidden wipe.
写明穿过的屏障和另一侧。静帧：[主体] 的穿越镜头，摄影机穿过墙、身体或窗户，仿佛物质可以忽略。视频：摄影机穿过建筑或 [主体] 进入下一个空间。要露出穿透的孔洞。禁止用隐藏的划像糊过去。
The camera passes through architecture or [Subject] into the next space.
摄影机穿过建筑或 [主体]，进入下一个空间。
pov: Describe the seen world, not the seer. Quote: What [Subject] sees: the world at their eye height, no back of a head, no shoulder of the looker in frame. Name whose eyes, the height, and the object of the look. For video, one motivated pan or walk as that person, still without their shoulder.
描述「被看到的世界」，而不是「看的人」。照抄这句：[主体] 所看到的：以他的眼睛高度呈现的世界，没有后脑勺，画面里也没有观看者的肩膀。写明是谁的眼睛、高度，以及看的对象。用于动态时，只做一次有动机的摇或走，仍然不出现他的肩膀。

At a crowded celebration, a character becomes overwhelmed. Keep the image continuous while voices lose clarity, room detail recedes and a small nearby glass movement becomes unusually prominent. Return gradually to the room when a friend touches her shoulder. Build the perceptual transition in sound post-production.
在拥挤的庆典上，一个角色逐渐招架不住。保持画面连续，同时让说话声变得模糊不清，房间细节退远，身旁一只玻璃杯的微小移动变得异常突出。当朋友碰到她肩膀时，再逐渐回到房间。这种知觉的过渡在声音后期里完成。
quick-cuts: Quick cuts around [Subject], shots shorter than a breath, rhythm as violence or music. List a progression of sizes (wide to eyes, or hands to kit) and a duration curve. For video, many distinct angles, short holds, no morph, and one planned pause if you need a landing.
[主体] 周围的快切：镜头比一次呼吸还短，节奏本身成为暴力或音乐。列出一套景别递进（从全景到眼睛，或从手到装备）和一条时长曲线。用于动态时，大量不同的角度、很短的停留、不要变形，如果需要落点就安排一次停顿。

Create a tense three-person card-game ending. Begin with wide spatial views, then progressively shorter shots of faces, hands and one face-down card. Accelerate the cutting while preserving who sits where, then hold a long silent close-up before the card turns. Assemble rhythm in the edit.
拍一场紧张的三人牌局结尾。先用宽的空间镜头，然后镜头越来越短：脸、手、一张扣着的牌。加快剪辑的同时保持谁坐在哪里的空间关系，然后在翻牌前用一个长时间无声的特写停住。节奏在剪辑里组装。
rack-focus: Name both planes and the duration. Still: Rack focus between planes around [Subject], a two-second pull from foreground to the figure or the reverse. Video: Focus racks from a named foreground element onto [Subject] over about two seconds, shallow depth of field, locked camera, no zoom.
写明两个层面和时长。静帧：[主体] 周围两层之间的焦点转移，用约两秒把焦点从前景拉到人物身上或反向拉回。视频：焦点从指定的前景物件在约两秒内转移到 [主体]，浅景深，摄影机锁定，不变焦。

Locked composition: a brass key in sharp foreground on a desk, a woman blurred in the doorway behind it. Hold the key, then slowly rack focus to her expression as the key becomes soft. No camera move, no zoom, neither object changes position.
固定构图：桌上一把黄铜钥匙在前景清晰，门边的女人在后景虚化。先停在钥匙上，再缓慢把焦点转移到她的表情，钥匙随之虚化。摄影机不动，不变焦，两个对象都不改变位置。
rain: Heavy rain around [Subject], backlit drops, wet-down pavement, umbrellas, silver streaks, weather as percussion. Name the backlight (a streetlamp, a sign, a HMI behind the rain), the wet ground, and drop size. For video, falling streaks in depth, splashes, no dry asphalt. Do not write a mood word in place of the water.
[主体] 周围的大雨：逆光下的雨滴、打湿的路面、雨伞、银色雨丝，把天气当打击乐。写明逆光源（路灯、招牌、雨后的 HMI 灯）、湿地面和雨滴大小。用于动态时，要有纵深里下落的雨丝和水花，不能出现干燥的柏油路。不要用情绪词代替「水」。
Heavy cinematic rain around [Subject], backlit drops, wet-down pavement, umbrellas, silver streaks, weather as percussion.
[主体] 周围电影感的大雨，逆光雨滴，打湿的路面，雨伞，银色雨丝，天气如打击乐。
reflections: Name the surface and both occupants. Reflections of [Subject] in glass, water, or chrome, observer and observed in one plane. Say shop window, one-way glass, puddle, or chrome. State who is real in front of the surface and who appears in it. Add camera hidden if the camera must not appear.
写明反射面和画面里的两个人。[主体] 在玻璃、水面或镀铬表面中的倒影，观看者与被观看者同处一个平面。说清是橱窗、单向玻璃、水洼还是镀铬。说明谁在反射面之前是真实的、谁出现在倒影里。如果摄影机不能入画，就补上「摄影机藏在画面外」。

A man and woman speak across a one-way-glass booth. Her illuminated face is visible while his dim reflection gradually overlays the glass as the light balance changes. Keep their positions consistent and the reflection optically plausible. Slow, restrained performance; no supernatural double.
一男一女隔着一间单向玻璃亭交谈。她被打亮的脸清晰可见，而随着光比变化，他昏暗的倒影逐渐叠加在玻璃上。两人的位置保持一致，反射在光学上说得通。表演缓慢克制；不要超自然的替身。
rule-of-thirds: Write the grid, not a mood. Rule-of-thirds placement of [Subject] on a power intersection, horizon on a third, breathing room in the look direction. Name which third holds the horizon and whether the figure sits left or right. Do not write balanced or well composed.
写出网格，而不是情绪。[主体] 放在三分线的力点上，地平线落在三分之一处，视线方向留出呼吸空间。写明地平线落在哪一条三分线、人物在左还是右。不要只写「平衡」「构图好」。
Rule-of-thirds placement of [Subject] on a power intersection, horizon on a third, breathing room in the look direction.
[主体] 按三分法放在力点上，地平线落在三分之一处，视线方向留出呼吸空间。
screen-in-screen: Specify the outer view and the inner picture. Screen-in-screen of [Subject], a monitor, phone, or cinema inside the cinema, nested looking. Name the device, the content on it, and whether we see the watcher, only the UI, or both. If text matters, write the exact words. Keep the inner image stable.
写明「外层画面」和「内层画面」。[主体] 的画中画：监视器、手机，或电影里的电影院，嵌套的观看。写明是什么设备、上面播放什么内容，以及我们看到的是观看者、只有界面，还是两者都有。如果文字重要，就把文字原样写出来。内层画面保持稳定。

Create a desktop-screen short: a woman starts writing an apology email, deletes it, receives an old photo and opens a video call she hesitates to answer. Generate the photo and call footage separately. Build the interface, readable text, cursor path and notification timing with code or compositing. No unreadable AI-generated UI text.
做一支桌面屏幕短片：一位女性开始写一封道歉邮件，删掉，收到一张旧照片，打开一个她犹豫要不要接的视频通话。照片与通话画面分别生成。界面、可读文字、光标路径和通知时机用代码或合成来做。不要出现 AI 生成的、读不出来的界面文字。
shallow-focus: Name the mark and the stop. Example: Very shallow focus on [Subject], T1.4, near eye sharp, background dissolved into optical discs, intimacy by exclusion, not a cutout mask.
写明对焦位置和光圈值。例：[主体] 的极浅景深，T1.4，靠近镜头的那只眼清晰，背景融成一个个光学圆盘，用「排除」制造亲密感，而不是剪贴蒙版。

An elderly ticket seller sits behind glass in a busy station. Tight portrait with the near eye sharp and the crowd reduced to soft, unrecognizable shapes. Tiny natural movements, stable eye focus, no plastic skin, no abrupt background replacement.
在繁忙车站里，一位年长的售票员坐在玻璃后面。紧凑的肖像，靠近镜头的那只眼清晰，人群虚化成无法辨认的柔软形状。细小的自然动作，对眼部对焦稳定，不要塑料感的皮肤，不要突兀的背景替换。
side-lighting: Put the lamp at 90 degrees. " Name hardness. Say whether the body or only the face is raked.
把灯放在 90 度位置。写明软硬程度。说明是身体还是只有脸被侧光照到。
Pure side light at 90 degrees on [Subject], half the face brilliant, half gone, texture and duality.
[主体] 上 90 度的纯侧光，半张脸明亮，半张脸隐没，质感与双重性。
slow-motion: Name the fps feel and what the extra time reveals. Still: a physically plausible mid-action pose with hanging dust, delayed fabric, and readable contacts, not a statue. Video: Slow-motion 6-second shot of [Subject], time stretched, particles hanging in light, 120fps feel, locked or simple camera, no frozen background orbit.
写明帧率感，以及多出来的时间揭示了什么。静帧：一个物理上成立的动作中段姿态，尘埃悬停，布料滞后，接触关系可读，而不是一尊雕像。视频：[主体] 的六秒慢动作，时间被拉长，粒子悬在光里，120fps 感，固定或简单运镜，不要冻结背景的环绕。

A glass slips from a waiter’s hand and falls in elegant slow motion. Fingers release naturally, the glass rotates coherently and fabric moves with plausible inertia. Locked close shot, smooth temporal detail, no frozen background or bullet-time orbit.
一只杯子从服务员手中滑落，以优雅的慢动作坠落。手指自然松开，杯子连贯地旋转，布料带着可信的惯性摆动。固定近景，时间细节流畅，不要冻结背景，也不要子弹时间式环绕。
smoke: Smoke around [Subject], cigarette, chimney, or battle, shafts of light catching it, volume in the room. Name the source, the backlight or side key, and the direction of the ribbon. For video, swirling volume, not a static fog plate, and a still-readable face.
[主体] 周围的烟雾：香烟、烟囱或战场，光柱照亮它，房间里有了体积。写明烟源、逆光还是侧主光，以及烟带的走向。用于动态时，要翻滚的体积感，而不是一张静止的雾片，同时脸依然可读。
Smoke around [Subject], cigarette, chimney, or battle, shafts of light catching it, volume in the room.
[主体] 周围的烟雾，香烟、烟囱或战场，光柱照亮它，房间里有了体积。
soft-light: Name a large source and gentle edges. " Keep a key side. Forbid razor nose shadows.
写明大面积光源和柔和的边缘。保持一个主光方向。禁止鼻子投下刀锋般的影子。
Soft wrapping light on [Subject] from a large source, gentle shadow transitions, luminous skin, Vermeer daylight.
[主体] 上柔和包裹的光，来自大面积光源，阴影过渡平缓，皮肤透亮，维米尔式的日光。
speed-ramp: Name the real-time approach, the stretched beat, and the recovery. Still: three readable phases implied in one pose is weaker than a video ramp. Video: Speed ramp: real-time movement of [Subject] suddenly stretches into slow motion at the key beat, then recovers. One coherent action, readable contacts, natural gravity.
写明实时部分、被拉长的那一拍，以及回到正常速度的过程。静帧：用一个姿态暗示三个阶段，效果弱于视频里的变速。视频：速度变化——[主体] 的实时动作在关键一拍突然拉成慢动作，然后恢复。动作连贯，接触关系可读，重力自然。

A skateboarder approaches a small ramp at normal speed, slows smoothly to reveal the board rotating beneath their feet, then returns to normal speed on landing. One coherent action, readable foot placement, natural gravity, no impossible extra spin. Specify and refine the ramp in editing.
滑板者以正常速度接近一个小坡道，平滑减速以露出板在脚下翻转，落地时恢复正常速度。一个连贯动作，脚位可读，重力自然，不要不可能的额外空转。速度曲线在剪辑里指定并微调。
split-screen: Split screen with [Subject] in one pane and another life in the other, simultaneous spaces, phone-call cinema or dual identity. Name the boundary, whether eyelines match, and what each pane contains. For video, two (or more) complete shots composited, not one image torn as a texture.
[主体] 在一格、另一种生活 在另一格的分屏，同时并存的空间，电话电影或双重身份。写明分界线、视线是否对位，以及每一格各有什么内容。用于动态时，是两条（或更多）完整镜头合成在一起，而不是把一张图当纹理撕开。

Show one lost-wallet incident three times: from the owner’s view, a cleaner’s view and a distant passenger’s view. Preserve the same station clock, movements and wallet position, but reveal different occluded actions each time. The third version resolves the apparent theft without inventing a new event.
把一次丢钱包事件展示三遍：失主的视角、清洁工的视角、远处乘客的视角。保留同一个车站时钟、同样的动作和钱包位置，但每次揭示不同的被遮挡动作。第三个版本解开这场看似盗窃的误会，而不是编出一件新事件。
static: Perfectly static locked-off shot of [Subject], heavy tripod, zero camera movement, composition doing all the work, living-picture stillness. For motion: completely locked-off camera. [Subject] may breathe or the air may move, but the frame does not.
[主体] 的完全静止固定镜头：重型三脚架，摄影机零运动，全靠构图做功，静物画般的静止。用于动态时：摄影机完全锁定。[主体] 可以呼吸、空气可以流动，但画面不动。

In a dark archive, a librarian listens for someone outside. Remove music entirely and retain only quiet ventilation, cloth movement and her restrained breathing. Let the ventilation stop, leaving a single distant latch click clearly exposed. No sudden monster reveal or oversized bass hit.
在昏暗的档案库里，图书管理员在听门外是否有人。完全去掉音乐，只留下轻微的通气声、布料摩擦和她压抑的呼吸。让通气声停下，把远处一声门闩的轻响清楚地暴露出来。不要突然出现的怪物，也不要过量的低频重击。
steadicam: Steadicam floating with [Subject] through connected spaces, preternatural smoothness, operator walking, light temperatures shifting as rooms change. For motion: smooth Steadicam move floating with [Subject] through the environment, no footfall shake.
